upstream_audit.finding: Default NO_ERROR_HANDLING drives rsp.error=0. Official ERROR_HANDLING has intermediate error and additional response semantics, so cannot be enabled transparently under flat one-request/one-response ABI.

canonical_wrapper_fix.contract: Single active flat request; capture AXI read/write error, drain current transfer normally, report failed response, reject subsequent requests until reset. Partially written destination is not rolled back.
canonical_wrapper_fix.response_buffer: One fall-through response entry. Internal response readiness is decoupled from consumer backpressure; stalled result/error stable. No additional normal-path response cycle.
